meta_description:
2,226 likes, 89 comments - anoushkalila on September 22, 2026: "I’ll be honest, before my most recent India trip I’d never given Delhi much time of day. It was usually just a gateway to Rajasthan, a brief stopover to get over my jet lag. On first glance, it fits all of the worst stereotypes that exist about India - crowded, loud, dirty. 

But on this trip, we actually made an effort to brush off the jet lag and see some of the city. And for the first time, I found myself actually understanding Delhi’s appeal. It has some wonderful sights, most notably the Qutub Minar which is the first image in this series. At sunrise, we had the place all to ourselves in the most beautiful morning glow, whilst a friendly security guard showed us some of the best photo spots. 

For golden hour, we headed back out to Humayun’s Tomb. It was busy, but not unpleasantly so. If anything, the atmosphere felt almost festive, with tourists from all over India converging to explore this spectacular monument. 

A moment, also, for our hotel, @theleelapalacenewdelhi. I genuinely don’t think I could visit Delhi and stay anywhere else now. The service was pristine, and we ate some of the best curries we’ve had there. 

So next time I’m in India, I’m going to make sure to give Delhi at least a couple of days. Beneath the surface, it’s really rather charming.
